indicator_verification.corridor_free_evidence: Refinement selection is strictly driven by the objective Abaqus MISESERI field from the same-load companion continuum solution. No predefined geometric corridor or manual crack-tip bias was applied.

scientific_qualification.companion_distinction: The companion model (Package 168) is an undamaged, homogeneous linear-elastic CPE4 continuum. Its MISESERI output is a recovery-based stress-discretization error indicator (Zienkiewicz-Zhu), not a direct phase-field damage error estimate. The companion stress field does not reproduce the degraded phase-field softening band, but accurately locates the zone of highest stress discretization error around the crack tip.
scientific_qualification.candidate_gate_discipline: Generation of the C6 candidate mesh does NOT constitute acceptance of the C6 state. Physical acceptance of C6 is deferred until nonmatching state transfer (u, d, H), energy integral continuity (< 2.0%), and Stage C3-0 re-equilibration pass their quantitative gates.

finding: Causal C5->C6 adaptive refinement decision and C6 candidate feasibility verified using authentic Package 168 Abaqus MISESERI data (Job 1419573). Denominator-guarded indicator (eta_g >= 0.15) marked 38 elements (0.29%) concentrated within 0.0033 mm of the crack tip without prescribed corridors. Conformal C6 quad mesh generated with 15252 CPE4 quads, 15559 nodes, positive Jacobians (min det(J)=1.562e-08), 59 duplicate slit pairs, h_min=0.00025 mm (<= ell_0/10), and coarsening strictly disabled (h_max=0.00200 mm <= 0.0025 mm). Labeled CANDIDATE_ONLY.
